description: Session-cookie authentication round trip against kvmd 4.186, plus every way the endpoints refuse one, recorded by hand with httpx (see README). Credentials are placeholders.

steps.name: login_json_body
steps.note: kvmd's login handler reads form fields; a JSON body arrives as empty user/passwd

result.error_msg: The argument '' is not a valid username characters

steps.name: login_wrong_passwd
steps.note: credentials the validators accept but the auth manager rejects

steps.name: login_invalid_user
steps.note: user name fails valid_user's regex before any lookup happens

result.error_msg: The argument 'ADMIN!' is not a valid username characters

steps.name: login_invalid_expire
steps.note: expire is validated as a non-negative number. Kept as documentation, not as a mock: login() types expire as an int, so a value this validator reads as something other than a number cannot leave this client

result.error_msg: The argument 'abc' is not a valid expiration time

steps.name: check_with_cookie
steps.note: session cookie accepted, no X-KVMD-* headers sent

steps.name: check_without_credentials
steps.note: no header, cookie or basic auth at all

steps.name: logout_without_cookie
steps.note: authorized by X-KVMD-* headers, but the handler needs the cookie to know which session to drop; the token value is hidden from the message by the validator. Kept as documentation, not as a mock: logout() refuses without a token rather than making a call that cannot succeed, so this is the answer it avoids rather than one it has to handle

result.error_msg: The argument is not a valid auth token

steps.name: logout
steps.note: drops every session of the token's owner, not only this one

steps.name: logout_refused
steps.note: the only way this endpoint refuses a call that carries a cookie: the auth chain stops at the first credential source present, so an unknown token with no headers, or valid-looking headers with a wrong password, both end here. 401 is unreachable once a cookie is sent; verified for every combination against kvmd 4.186
